intro: Puducherry (Pondicherry), the former French enclave on the Coromandel coast, has a sea wall rather than a sandy beach in its historic centre. For sand and swimming, visitors head a few kilometres out of town: south to Paradise Beach and Eden beach, or north to Serenity and the beaches near Auroville, which lie just across the border in Tamil Nadu.
This guide explains which beach suits what. For the French Quarter, cafes and Auroville, see things to do in Pondicherry.
quickAnswer: The best beaches around Puducherry are Paradise Beach, a sandbar reached by boat from the Chunnambar boat house south of town; Serenity Beach in Kottakuppam for surf lessons; the beaches near Auroville for quiet; and Eden beach at Chinna Veerampattinam. The Promenade (Rock Beach) in the French Quarter is for evening walks, not swimming. Visit from about November to March.
takeaways: Rock Beach (the Promenade) is a sea wall for walks; swimming is not allowed there.
Paradise Beach is reached by a short boat ride from the Chunnambar boat house; boats stop by late afternoon.
Serenity Beach, about 5 km north, has surf schools.
Auroville's beaches and Serenity are technically in Tamil Nadu, just outside Puducherry's boundary.
The north-east monsoon (about October to December) brings heavy rain and rough sea.

items.name: The Promenade (Rock Beach)
body: Goubert Avenue runs along the sea wall in the French Quarter, with the Gandhi statue, the old lighthouse and the war memorial. It is closed to traffic at certain hours, and crowds come for evening walks and sunrise. Swimming is not allowed: the shore is rocks and the water deepens suddenly.

items.name: Paradise Beach
body: A sandbar between the Chunnambar backwater and the sea, reached by a short boat ride from the Chunnambar boat house, run by Puducherry tourism, at Nonankuppam about 8 km south of town. Boats run in the day and the last trips leave by late afternoon.

items.name: Eden beach
body: At Chinna Veerampattinam, south of the town, a managed beach that has held Blue Flag certification.

facts.Best for: A clean beach close to town

items.name: Serenity Beach
body: In Kottakuppam, about 5 km north of the French Quarter, Serenity has surf schools, cafes and a relaxed crowd.

items.name: Auroville's beaches
body: The beaches near Auroville, about 10 km north, are quiet stretches with a few cafes and guesthouses.

sections.heading: Planning
list: Puducherry is about three hours by road from Chennai along the East Coast Road, which also passes Mahabalipuram.
Rent a scooter or bicycle to get between the French Quarter, Serenity and Auroville.
Two to three days covers the town and beaches; add Mahabalipuram on the way from Chennai.

safety: Do not swim at the Promenade (Rock Beach).
Swim only at beaches with lifeguards, inside the flagged zone, and never when a red flag is up or during the monsoon.
The sea off this coast can be rough with strong currents; surf only with a school.
Check cyclone warnings from October to December.
Keep to the boat schedule at Paradise Beach; do not stay after the last boat.
packing: Light clothes and modest wear for temples and the Ashram

faqs.q: Which is the best beach in Pondicherry?
faqs.a: Paradise Beach for sand and a boat ride, and Serenity for surfing.

faqs.q: Can you swim at Rock Beach in Pondicherry?
faqs.a: No. It is a rocky sea wall; swimming is not allowed.

faqs.q: How do you get to Paradise Beach?
faqs.a: By a short boat ride from the Chunnambar boat house, about 8 km south of the town.

faqs.q: Where can I surf in Pondicherry?
faqs.a: At Serenity Beach in Kottakuppam, with local surf schools.
